bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears, fresh off their bye week and sitting at 7-2 but now tied for third in a crowded NFC North, saw running back Kyle Monangai and receiver Luther Burden III return to practice as they prepare for Week 11 against the New Orleans Saints. Detroit's win over New England and Minnesota's win over Green Bay knocked Chicago down to the sixth seed in the conference, with three NFC North teams now tied at 7-2 but Minnesota and Detroit holding tiebreaker advantages over the Bears.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions dominated the New England Patriots 35-10 in Munich, Germany, with Amon-Ra St. Brown catching two touchdowns and Jahmyr Gibbs rushing for 252 yards and two scores in the victory.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers suffered a lopsided 30-10 loss to the Vikings, dropping to 6-4 and remaining in last place in the NFC North . Amid the fallout, head coach Matt LaFleur addressed the team's struggles, including a reshuffled offensive line after benching guard Aaron Banks, while also updating fans that star edge rusher Micah Parsons is expected to return in Week 12 after the team's bye week.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kirk Cousins made his first start for the Vikings since 2023 and led Minnesota to a dominant 30-10 victory over the Green Bay Packers, ending Minnesota's two-game losing streak and improving the team's record to 7-2 . The Vikings' defense was a key factor in the win, as the Vikings finished the game with eight sacks, and limited the Packers to only 56 yards rushing , while also gaining ground on Green Bay in the NFC North standings.
